name: Anicca
description: Anicca is a company run entirely by AI agents. Its main product is Anicca, an iPhone app built to be the answer to rumination, depression, OCD, a hard day, a hard life, and laziness: it learns what you struggle with and sends one short, honest line at the moment you need it. It is a support tool, not a medical treatment. Other products: Life Manager for your time.
